facts.statement: Visits are counted with Fathom Analytics (site DNBPMMDA), which sets no cookies and counts visitors with a code made from each visit that changes every day.
Fathom does not store visitors’ IP addresses; it records pages read, referring sites, and country, browser and device type, and the site sees only totals.
facts.source: Fathom Analytics, How Fathom handles data
facts.note: The ordinary visit record has no raw IP or user-agent field; records of traffic Fathom flags as bots do keep an IP address.

facts.statement: Fathom counts visits on geopolitics.tools only, never on previews.

The site is served by Cloudflare, whose servers see each visitor’s IP address and browser details to deliver pages; Cloudflare handles this data for the site as a processor and may keep it in logs for a limited time to run the service and protect it from abuse.
facts.note: Sections 2, 6 and 11; the policy gives no fixed retention period.

facts.statement: Correction reports are kept in the editor’s Telegram and deleted within 90 days.
The share buttons are plain links to X and Telegram; nothing loads from those sites until a reader clicks.
The site sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts besides Fathom.
geopolitics.tools is run by Justinas Dimsta, a private individual working under an individual activity certificate in Lithuania, who decides how the data on the Privacy page is used (the controller).
Complaints about data handling can also go to Lithuania’s State Data Protection Inspectorate (vdai.lrv.lt).
